bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
image=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-8f3cee44
expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$image")" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$expected" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
docker exec "$name" node --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
work="$repo/.worktrees/notice-user-8f3cee44"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = 8f3cee44a2ba0dcde5cbf183cc34d46e74434863 || exit 74
test -f "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/noticeInteractions.ts" || exit 81
test -f "$work/artifacts/bot/src/services/noticeEditor.ts" || exit 81
grep -Fq "Room持ち込み" "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/postingHandlers.ts" || exit 82
grep -Fq "pc:from:room" "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/postingHandlers.ts" || exit 82
grep -Fq "startCompactProfileEditor" "$work/artifacts/bot/src/gaybbsBot.ts" || exit 83
grep -Fq "startSearchEditor" "$work/artifacts/bot/src/gaybbsBot.ts" || exit 83
gates="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT feature||':'||CASE WHEN enabled THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature IN ('announcement','room','profile','search') ORDER BY feature;")"
echo GATES_BEGIN
printf '%s\n' "$gates"
echo GATES_END
schema="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('notice_dm_sessions','notice_direct_messages');")"
test "$schema" -eq 2 || exit 84
topics="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL;")"
echo VERIFIED_NOTICE_DESTINATIONS="$topics"
echo NOTICE_DM_TABLES=PASS
echo COMPLETED_FEATURE_SOURCE_PRESERVED=PASS
echo NOTICE_LIVE_IMAGE=PASS
echo TELEGRAM_NOTICE_E2E=NOT_VERIFIED
